intervention: Transport dedicated full-resolution protected luminance, intrinsic-risk memory, and red-safety authority with verified optical correspondence and explicit disocclusion reset, while keeping displayed chroma current.
automated_observation: Automated GPU validation passed SC 2.3.1 and SC 2.3.2, but this experiment is rejected as the next behavioral baseline. Moving-flash reduction was 0.28924819 versus 0.29455287 in alpha.10 and 0.60489436 in alpha.9; small-moving ghost MAE was 0.00014260; pan MAE was 0.00765287; 5 Hz quarter-screen luminance reduction fell to 0.83621016. The dedicated state architecture remains useful evidence, but it did not restore moving-flash memory and slightly worsened several motion metrics.
qualitative_observation: Subsequent manual testing reported that visible trailing/ghosting remained heavy and that lower-contrast static flashing was more noticeable, reinforcing that the existing aggregate ghost MAE and standards gates are insufficient as perceptual regression targets.
